name: Vulnerary
lore: Wax, herbs, and a prayer you only need it once.

name: Elixir
lore: Mends the body whole. Few know the recipe now.

name: Master Seal
lore: An old rite pressed in wax. It remakes the one it names.

name: Energy Drop
lore: Drink it and a month of drills passes in an afternoon.

name: Spirit Dust
lore: Ground ward-stone that loosens the old words.

name: Secret Book
lore: One duelist's footwork, diagrammed in a careful hand.

name: Speedwing
lore: A pegasus feather, still restless in the hand.

name: Dracoshield
lore: Sewn into a gambeson, one dragon scale turns a killing blow.

name: Talisman
lore: A seer's charm, worn against hexes.

name: Angelic Robe
lore: Temple cloth, blessed once and holding it still.

name: Swiftsoles
lore: Courier's boots that make any road shorter.

name: Infantry Seal
lore: Reassignment to the foot ranks, stamped and final.

name: Mounted Seal
lore: Rank and a mount to bear it, of the few that remain.

name: Herb
lore: Bitter fen-leaf that loosens poison's grip.

name: Remedy
lore: Antidote and bandage packed in one tin.
